verdict_text:
YES

The script loads all three checkpoints first, verifies identical key sets and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor against the base before any writing, then computes each merged tensor from the unmodified `base` tensor (no in-place mutation, since `out = dict(base)` only rebinds new tensors), matching the required formula with `lambda = 0.4` in float32. The regex `fullmatch` selects exactly the three MLP weights per layer, and the `merged == 48` and `len(out) == 114` assertions plus the equality assertions provide the three required loud failures. The single output file lands at `out/T4/model.safetensors` by default, and all other tensors are carried over from the base untouched.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
